what: Sub-test G fixtures proposed with GH_VIEW_SECOND_HEAD_OID="$STUB_PR_HEAD_OID" expand an unset shell variable under set -u
scenario_or_breakage: The harness aborts with an unbound variable before exercising the new retry cases because STUB_PR_HEAD_OID only has a default inside the fake gh stub, not in the parent test shell
suggested_fix: Use a literal aaaa1111 or set STUB_PR_HEAD_OID=aaaa1111 alongside GH_VIEW_SECOND_HEAD_OID; alternatively use ${STUB_PR_HEAD_OID:-aaaa1111} in the fixture

what: Initial UNKNOWN recovery does not re-run the BEHIND pre-CI route after retries resolve to BEHIND
scenario_or_breakage: If the first view returns UNKNOWN, a retry returns BEHIND, and CI is pending, the proposed flow can emit ci_not_ready instead of the existing main_advanced branch-freshness signal and can run unnecessary checks
suggested_fix: After retry recovery, re-check BEHIND before refresh_ci_state, or centralize stable merge-state routing before the CI gate; add a G case for UNKNOWN-to-BEHIND with failing CI
